notes.title: NVIDIA DLSS 3 is now supported in F.I.S.T.
notes.content:
For NVIDIA DLSS 2 and DLSS 3 users:

1. Update the game
2. Update the NVIDIA drive to the latest version
3. Enter the game, go to "Video" settings in Options from MAIN MENU, check new options for DLSS 2 and 3

notes.title: Steam Demo Updated!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420493/e3a85e878185bb6ab05c0178298537682affabeb.png

Steam Demo of F.I.S.T.: Forged In Shadow Torch is now updated! And here are some tips we wish you to know about:

1. New demo supports all languages that has been supported in the main game, and also supports all graphic options. 
2. Old saved data from former demo will be invalid after this update. Saved data generated by the new demo can be used in the main game.
3. To avoid possible saved data conflicts, we highly suggest players that have already installed the main game NOT TO download the new demo.
   *Playing this new demo after gaining progress in the main game may cause some problem! It will be safer to delete the demo if you already have the main game.
4. Fixed some minor bugs and dialogues
5. This new demo will need 12 GB space to install

Thank you for all your love and support! It's time to say goodbye to year 2021, Happy New Year to all ! :-)

notes.title: 1.200 Updates - Boss Rush, Soundtrack and Mini Artbook
notes.content:
Hello everyone, just like what we've talked about before, here comes the updates for December, as well as the biggest one so far!

1. BOSS RUSH - “Hey look who's back, little bunny?”

Now after complete the story, we can find a glowing portal that seems leading to nowhere in the map. Just jump in, and ……oh, that machine looks familiar, but a little different!
Choose your opponent, and maybe dare to choose a tougher condition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420493/0569c5aebd288694afa6da257f5eca2338b66479.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420493/79af3056135d4a36b279261e80de9a8e530fd060.png

2. Soundtracks and Mini Artbook - for free！
We've F.I.S.T.'s original soundtracks. You can enjoy the music from the game's home page, or just download original soundtrack product that has been released on Steam.
Tribute to the talented composer Caisheng Bo, who had created unforgettable soundtracks and theme music for the game!

We can also find many unpublished concept arts that shows some part of early designs of the map, characters and items. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420493/24788494a2d4bd107fbe20d62f41a651f2ad0262.jpg

3. Fixed some overlapping problem of supported languages.
I believe we have fixed most of them... at least most.

notes.title: 1.004.006 Patch Notes for PC
notes.content:
● Fixed a bug that a specific door in Underwater Base does not open in ultra-wide resolution (21:9 or above).
● Fixed a bug that the map in the Mine can not reach 100% completion in some languages (French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian).
● Fixed the display error when switching weapons with the keyboard.
● Optimized the UI of switching weapons. The weapon UI will display once the input for changing is received now.
● Optimized the cutscenes of the fights with Cicero. They can be skipped when retrying the fight.
● Optimized the chasing sequence in Ancient Complex. It gets easier under Easy difficulty now.
● Other minor bug fixes and optimizations.
